#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class CMisterBAndBoringGame {
public:
    void solve() {
        int a, b, l, r;
        cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
        l -= 1;
        r -= 1;

        int min_result = 26;
        for (char p = 'a'; p <= 'z'; p++) {
            for (char q = 'a' + a; q <= 'z'; q++) {
                string rep;
                for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) rep += (char)('a' + i);
                for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) rep += p;

                for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
                    vector<bool> f(26, false);
                    for (int j = b; j < a + b + i; j++) {
                        f[rep[j] - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j < 26; j++) {
                        if (!f[j]) {
                            rep += (char)('a' + j);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) rep += q;

                vector<bool> flag(26, false);
                if (r - l + 1 >= 100000) {
                    for (char c : rep) {
                        flag[c - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
                        flag[rep[i % rep.size()] - 'a'] = true;
                    }
                }

                int ans = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
                    if (flag[i]) ans++;
                }
                min_result = min(ans, min_result);
            }
        }
        cout << min_result << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    CMisterBAndBoringGame solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
